facts.fact: According to Bain & Company research cited by Adwave, a 5% increase in customer retention can lead to a 25% to 95% increase in profits.
facts.quote: A 5% increase in customer retention can lead to a 25% to 95% increase in profits, according to Bain & Company research cited in this analysis.

facts.fact: According to Dynamic Business, for most SMEs losing a single mid-tier client costs between 3 and 8 times what they initially estimate.
facts.quote: losing a single mid-tier client costs between 3 and 8 times what they initially estimate, because standard formulas miss disrupted workflows

facts.fact: According to Vendaq, acquiring a new customer costs 5 to 25 times more than retaining an existing one.
facts.unit: times (cost of new vs. retained customer)
facts.quote: acquiring a new customer costs 5 to 25 times more than retaining an existing one

facts.fact: According to Outsource Accelerator, healthy customer churn should be 5% or below.
facts.quote: healthy churn should be 5% or below

facts.fact: According to Outsource Accelerator, existing customers convert at 60% to 70%.
According to Outsource Accelerator, new prospects convert at 5% to 20%.
The page gives the churn rate formula as lost customers during a period divided by customers at the start of that period, multiplied by 100.
facts.quote: Churn rate = (Customers lost during a period / Customers at the start of that period) × 100

facts.fact: The page gives the direct cost of churn as lost customers multiplied by average customer value, and notes this excludes hidden costs.
facts.quote: Cost of churn = Lost customers × average customer value

facts.fact: In the page's worked example, starting customers are 1,000.
In the page's worked example, lost customers are 50.
In the page's worked example, the churn rate is 5%.
In the page's worked example, average customer value is $200.
In the page's worked example, direct churn cost is $10,000.
Per Churnkey (a third-party source cited by the page), the replacement cost for a lost client in sectors such as real estate and auto sales can range from $200 to $1,500 or more.
facts.quote: replacement cost for a lost client can range from $200 to $1,500 or more
